jobs.title: Hazardous Materials Associate (Part Time)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Hazardous Materials Inventory Associate (Part-Time)
Job Description

We are seeking a Part-Time Hazardous Waste Specialist to support an environmental testing laboratory. This individual will ensure compliance with hazardous waste regulations and address findings from a recent regulatory audit. The position offers flexibility, either as a short-term project or an ongoing part-time engagement.

Responsibilities

Manage hazardous waste inventory, storage, and documentation for laboratory operations.
Perform weekly inspections of satellite hazardous waste accumulation areas.
Support onsite and offsite hazardous waste storage activities.
Classify expired chemicals for monthly lab packing and disposal activities.
Manage and monitor chemical neutralization stations.
Ensure all required hazardous waste records and regulatory documentation are maintained accurately.
Review, update, and improve SOPs, work instructions, and supporting compliance documentation.
Assist with corrective actions related to regulatory audit findings.
Troubleshoot hazardous waste handling and compliance issues.
Partner with laboratory, quality, and operations personnel to maintain safe waste management practices.
Follow established safety procedures and chemical handling protocols.

Essential Skills

Experience with hazardous waste management in a laboratory, environmental, chemical, manufacturing, or related setting.
Current or previous HAZWOPER training preferred.
Knowledge of hazardous waste regulations and compliance requirements.
Experience performing inspections, maintaining waste inventories, and managing documentation.
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs.
Safe chemical handling experience.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience with hazardous materials handling, chemical inventory, and regulatory documentation.
Familiarity with EHS, environmental health and safety, laboratory operations, chemical classifications, MSDS, SOP, safety, chemical storage, RCRA, EPA compliance, and EPA methods.

Work Environment

The role is based in an environmental testing laboratory, offering a part-time opportunity averaging 16-24 hours per week. The position is flexible, allowing for a project-based or long-term engagement. There is potential for additional laboratory support work as business needs require, including glass wash and cross-training activities. The laboratory is a stable, long-standing environmental lab with satellite offices throughout the state.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Santa Paula, CA.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $20.00 - $24.00/hr.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to specific elections, plan, or program terms. If eligible, the benefits available for this temporary role may include the following: Medical, dental & vision Critical Illness, Accident, and Hospital 401(k) Retirement Plan Pre-tax and Roth post-tax contributions available Life Insurance (Voluntary Life & AD&D for the employee and dependents) Short and long-term disability Health Spending Account (HSA) Transportation benefits Employee Assistance Program Time Off/Leave (PTO, Vacation or Sick Leave)

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Santa Paula, CA.

Application Deadline

This position is anticipated to close on Oct 30, 2026.

Workplace Type

This is a fully onsite position in Santa Paula,CA.

About Actalent

Actalent is a global leader in engineering and sciences services and talent solutions. We help visionary companies advance their engineering and science initiatives through access to specialized experts who drive scale, innovation and speed to market. With a network of almost 20,000 consultants and 5,000 clients across the U.S., Canada, Asia and Europe, Actalent serves many of the Fortune 500. We are proud to be an Engineering News-Record (ENR) Top 500 Design Firm for our engineering design services and a ClearlyRated Best of Staffing® winner for both client and talent service.

The company is an equal opportunity employer and will consider all applications without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information or any characteristic protected by law.

If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, such as the modification or adjustment of the job application process or interviewing process due to a disability, please email actalentaccommodation@actalentservices.com for other accommodation options.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, for all positions located in the city and county of San Francisco, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
